claims.statement: Alibaba claims the Zhenwu V900 delivers three times the performance of the M890 with 216GB of memory.

headline: Alibaba unveils new AI chip alongside six-year datacenter expansion plan
summary: Alibaba Cloud announced plans to build 20GW of datacenter capacity over six years and unveiled its Zhenwu V900 AI accelerator chip to power them, claiming three times the performance of its M890 chip with 216GB of memory.
